decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the song 'It's Raining'. The provided sources explicitly identify two distinct songs with this title by different artists. Document D1 (segments D1S1-D1S4) confirms 'It's Raining' is a soul/R&B ballad recorded by Irma Thomas in 1961. Document D3 (segments D3S1-D3S6) confirms 'It's Raining' is a Korean language song by the R&B singer Rain, released in 2004. As different artists can legitimately release works with identical titles, both 'Irma Thomas' and 'Rain' are valid, distinct answers corresponding to their respective songs found in the source text.
